name: Calf Raise
instruction: Rise onto balls of feet without rolling ankles, pause, lower slowly.

name: Chair Balance Reach
instruction: Settle beside a sturdy chair, reach without tipping, then return.

name: Dumbbell Chest Press
instruction: Lower dumbbells under control towards chest level, then press smoothly.

name: Dead Bug
instruction: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent. Gently press your lower back towards the floor, then slowly reach the opposite arm and leg away without letting your back lift.
move: opposite arm and leg extend slowly · trunk position unchanged
finish: return to start without momentum · alternate sides

name: Glute Bridge
instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Brace gently, drive through your heels and lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees form a long line; lower slowly.
move: hips rise through glute drive · ribs remain controlled
finish: shoulders-hips-knees form long line · lower under control

name: Goblet Squat
instruction: Set your feet where they feel natural. Hold the weight close to your chest. Sit your hips back and down, keep your chest proud, then drive through the whole foot to stand tall.
start: feet stable around shoulder-width/natural stance · weight held close to sternum/chest
move: hips travel back and down · knees track broadly with toes
finish: stand tall under control · hips and knees extended without hyperextension

name: Hamstring Mobility
instruction: Move gently to a mild stretch behind the thigh; never force range.

name: Hip Flexor Mobility
instruction: Tuck pelvis gently and shift only to a mild front-hip stretch.

name: Hip Hinge
instruction: Soften your knees, push your hips backwards as though closing a car door with your bum, stop when the hamstrings tighten, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
move: hips travel backwards · shins stay relatively quiet
finish: hips return under control · stand tall without leaning back

name: Lat Pulldown
instruction: Drive elbows down, pull towards upper chest, then lengthen arms under control.

name: Loaded Carry
instruction: Stand tall with loads close to sides and walk with controlled steps.

name: Low-Impact March
instruction: March smoothly with comfortable knee lift and natural arm swing.

name: Overhead Press
instruction: Press from shoulder height overhead without leaning back; lower under control.

name: Plank
instruction: Set elbows under shoulders and make a long line through your body. Brace, breathe normally and hold only while that shape stays solid.
finish: same body line maintained until controlled release

name: Push-Up
instruction: Set your hands just outside shoulder width, make a straight line from head to heels or knees, lower your chest between your hands and press the floor away.
start: hands stable just outside shoulder width · head-to-heel/knee line controlled
move: elbows bend under control · chest travels towards support/floor
finish: press support away · arms long without aggressive elbow lock

name: Reverse Lunge
instruction: Stand tall, step one foot back and lower straight down until both knees bend comfortably. Push through the front foot to return to standing.
move: one foot steps back · both knees bend comfortably
finish: push through front foot · return to balanced standing

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instruction: Brace one hand on a bench or support and hinge with a long spine. Pull the dumbbell towards your hip, squeeze the shoulder blade back, then lower until the arm is long again.
move: elbow travels towards hip · shoulder blade retracts without torso rotation
finish: dumbbell returns under control · arm long without shoulder dumping forward

name: Rowing Erg
instruction: Drive legs, then body, then arms; return arms, body, then knees.

name: Shadow Boxing
instruction: Punch into open space with control and return hands to guard.

name: Sit-to-Stand
instruction: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet comfortable and slightly behind your knees. Lean forward a touch, drive through your feet and stand tall; sit back down under control.
start: seated near chair front · feet planted
move: torso inclines slightly · hips rise as knees extend
finish: stand tall under control · reverse to seated position without dropping

name: Stationary Bike
instruction: Set saddle appropriately and pedal smoothly at prescribed effort.

name: Step-Up
instruction: Put the whole foot on the step. Lean forward slightly, drive through the foot on the step and stand tall on top; lower yourself back down under control.
start: whole working foot on step · support available if needed
move: body rises primarily from step leg · knee tracks with foot
finish: stand controlled on step · lower under control

name: Thoracic Rotation
instruction: Keep hips quiet and rotate through upper back smoothly.

name: Triceps Extension
instruction: Keep upper arm steady, straighten elbow, then return under control.

name: Walking
instruction: Walk tall at a controlled pace with natural arm swing.

name: Wall Slides
instruction: Slide arms upward in comfortable range while keeping ribs controlled.
